title: Определитель целочисленной матрицы
prompt:
Compute the determinant of the following 6×6 integer matrix A.

A =
[ -2   1   0  -4   4   2 ]
[  4   2   2   3  -4   3 ]
[  1  -1   3   3  -3   4 ]
[  1   0   4   0  -2   2 ]
[  4   1   2   2   1   0 ]
[  1   2   1   0   2  -2 ]

Give the exact value as an integer.

Think it through, then finish with a final line of the form `ANSWER: <your answer>`.
